# parson JSON parser provenance

- Upstream: https://github.com/kgabis/parson
- Upstream commit: `ba29f4eda9ea7703a9f6a9cf2b0532a2605723c3`
- Upstream license: MIT
- Upstream license file: `third_party/parson/LICENSE`
- Local file: `lib/xapi_json_impl.inc`
- Local SHA256: `437c7a322c8eac21a53ac4bac453db423fbc0bec69f27ac0faaaa35f95e1f516`

`lib/xapi_json_impl.inc` provides the XAPI JSON parser implementation used by
the kernel and user runtime. Its recursive-descent parser structure is recorded
here against parson so the MIT copyright notice accompanies source and binary
distributions.
